status: Acceptance obligations for future independent validators; not an implemented authorization engine.

checks.requirement: Validate the schema dialect, required fields, conditional rules, and date/time formats.
checks.rejection_case: Reject an unsupported version, unknown artifact type, or missing required payload field.

checks.requirement: Reject example-mode records as operational inputs or evidence.
checks.rejection_case: A placeholder example cannot authorize work even when its JSON validates.

checks.requirement: Resolve references to exact owning-repository artifact revisions and verify byte hashes.
checks.rejection_case: Reject missing, moving, mismatched, or withdrawn references; cross-repository access requires separate authorization.

checks.requirement: Authenticate creator, critics, decider, and delegation scope.
checks.rejection_case: A role claim or renamed actor field cannot establish an identity or delegation.

checks.requirement: Resolve target-specific authority through the decision matrix and upstream bounds.
checks.rejection_case: Reject decisions by the wrong role or outside delegated authority.

checks.requirement: Require CEO approval for Solution Architect-authored decisions and baseline changes.
checks.rejection_case: Architect authorship or a technical review alone cannot replace CEO acceptance.

checks.requirement: Require human-owner approval for every allowed guideline departure.
checks.rejection_case: Reject directive waivers and explicit source absolute prohibitions, including twenty-operation contracts.

checks.requirement: Verify required independent critics and findings disposition against exact reviewed bytes.
checks.rejection_case: Reject self-critique, absent required roles, or open blocking findings presented as successful review.

checks.requirement: Keep implementation and test workers from approving their own deliverables.
checks.rejection_case: Changing claimed roles does not evade identity-based independence.

checks.requirement: Validate the construction handoff against reviewed requirements, system design, detailed design, and selected SDP.
checks.rejection_case: A PM assignment cannot stand in for missing design reviews or management acceptance.

checks.requirement: Preserve SRS-review branching and STP-review dependency.
checks.rejection_case: Do not require successful STP review ahead of construction; require it ahead of STP-based testing.

checks.requirement: Resolve an instruction’s declared bounds against the actual supplied upstream revisions.
checks.rejection_case: AA/TA instruction changes cannot silently alter another owner’s input or PM assignment.

checks.requirement: Require impact-specific decisions and reassessment for affected changed inputs.
checks.rejection_case: Old approval evidence does not approve a new revision or silently amend commitments.

checks.requirement: Validate pass evidence against the reviewed plan and actual integrated source revisions.
checks.rejection_case: A passing component test does not replace required system, regression, or real-service integration tests.

checks.requirement: Credit binary phase completion only from the applicable successful reviews/tests and approved weight basis.
checks.rejection_case: Reject spent tokens, time, commits, or incomplete phases presented as earned completion.

checks.requirement: Check all three positions and summary before counting a conflict round.
checks.rejection_case: Reject duplicate round numbers or changed dispute references counted toward the same conflict.

checks.requirement: Escalate remaining disagreement after three completed rounds.
checks.rejection_case: A fourth discussion round cannot postpone required CEO escalation.

checks.requirement: Keep framework authority, role delegations, and integration settings protected from worker changes.
checks.rejection_case: Schema validity does not substitute for independent identities and permission boundaries.

checks.requirement: Confirm PM assignments preserve one developer per component and one component per developer at a time.
checks.rejection_case: Multiple assignments cannot create unauthorized concurrent implementation ownership; preserve the book’s pair-programming distinction.

checks.requirement: Assess final versus draft state independently of authorization.
checks.rejection_case: A final review, test report, or artifact is not an approved work instruction without required decision evidence.

checks.requirement: Evaluate lifecycle gates for an exact current context and required evidence.
checks.rejection_case: Do not treat an old passed gate result or a schema-valid flag as permanent permission.

checks.requirement: Preserve bounded exploration before complete detailed design and parallel test planning.
checks.rejection_case: Do not require STP approval for construction or require complete detailed design to start assigned design exploration.

checks.requirement: Use recorded no-impact review and a new revision-bound decision for editorial reaffirmation.
checks.rejection_case: A worker’s editorial classification cannot transfer approval automatically.

checks.requirement: Enforce only approved explicit freshness requirements.
checks.rejection_case: Age alone does not expire an approval; an explicit applicable expiry cannot be ignored.

checks.requirement: Verify withdrawal/revocation authority and effective scope.
checks.rejection_case: Workers cannot revoke another role’s approval; human-owner approvals remain reserved to that owner.

checks.requirement: Reassess transitive affected evidence and keep unrelated approved work available.
checks.rejection_case: Do not resume affected work on stale inputs or impose an unassessed suite-wide invalidation.

checks.requirement: Keep historical reports and decisions immutable while showing current rework and validity.
checks.rejection_case: Do not erase consumed effort or represent unsupported phase credit as current completion.
